start.name: {name}
start.text: *April, cherry blossom petals scattering in front of the school gate. I smooth the still-stiff collar of my new uniform and resettle the strap of the bag holding my transfer papers.*

start_again.name: {name}
start_again.text: *A sudden rush of dizziness hits, and I brace against the cold gate pillar. I slowly breathe out and wait for the queasiness inside to settle.*

start_3.name: {name}
start_3.text: *The phone in my pocket buzzes once. I look down for a moment at the familiar names that popped up over the old school group chat, then quietly turn the screen off.*

gate_1.name: {name}
gate_1.text: *Under the shade of the gate, a girl with long straight hair pushes her glasses up and checks her watch. As my footsteps draw closer, her neat lashes slowly lift.*

seoyeon_meet_1.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_1.text: You the transfer student who came today? {name}, right?

seoyeon_meet_2.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_2.text: Name tag says {name} too. Nice to meet you. *Her neat fingertips leave a light mark on the list on the clipboard.*

seoyeon_meet_3.name: {name}
seoyeon_meet_3.text: That's me. How'd you recognize my face right away?

seoyeon_meet_4.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_4.text: I'm the student council president. Welcoming new transfer students is my job too.

seoyeon_meet_5.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_5.text: Follow me. Before homeroom starts, I'll walk you through the school layout in 15 minutes.

seoyeon_meet_6.name: {name}
seoyeon_meet_6.text: The student council president showing me around herself on day one... kind of nerve-racking.

seoyeon_meet_7.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_7.text: It's the job I was given. No need to make a big deal out of it.

seoyeon_meet_8.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_8.text: Alright, let's go. *As Seoyeon turns, a faint scent of fabric softener dried in the sun brushes off the collar of her uniform shirt.*

seoyeon_choice.name: {name}
seoyeon_choice.text: *I look at Seoyeon's neat back as she walks ahead, and I speak.*
choices: Wait — you didn't come all the way out here just for me, did you?
So what's the tour gonna cost me?
It's fine, I'll just figure it out myself.

choice_dismiss_1.name: Seoyeon
choice_dismiss_1.text: It's your first day. You really okay finding it on your own, {name}? *She stops and turns her head halfway to look at me.*

choice_dismiss_2.name: Seoyeon
choice_dismiss_2.text: If that's what you want, I won't drag you. Just remember the classroom. Class 3-2, far end of the hall on the right.

choice_dismiss_3.name: Seoyeon
choice_dismiss_3.text: *She tucks the clipboard against her chest and climbs the stairs inside the gate with a steady step.*

choice_flirt_1.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_1.text: *She stops, turns halfway, and the corners of her eyes curve just a little behind the clear lenses.*

choice_flirt_2.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_2.text: Room to joke on your first day as a transfer. I'll have your name memorized in one go.

choice_flirt_3.name: {name}
choice_flirt_3.text: Oh, are you scoring first impressions or something?

choice_flirt_4.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_4.text: Well. You don't seem to know the school yet, but that first impression is worth a pretty generous score.

choice_flirt_5.name: {name}
choice_flirt_5.text: A generous score from the student council president? I'm honored.

choice_flirt_6.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_6.text: We'll see if you can still smile that easily a week from now.

choice_flirt_7.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_7.text: We'll be late. Follow me, {name}. *She covers a slightly flushed ear with her hair and walks a step ahead.*

choice_joke_1.name: Seoyeon
choice_joke_1.text: Today's tour is free, just this once. I'll collect it with interest later, when the student council is short on hands.

choice_joke_2.name: {name}
choice_joke_2.text: They say nothing's free. Scary student council president.

choice_joke_3.name: Seoyeon
choice_joke_3.text: Stick with me and school at least won't be boring.

hallway_1.name: Seoyeon
hallway_1.text: No need to slow down returning hellos from everyone we pass. Just match my pace. *She answers the greetings pouring through the hall with a light raise of her hand.*

hallway_3.name: Seoyeon
hallway_3.text: The main building we're walking through is the third-year building, and the library is across the windows. Go down the basement stairs and the snack bar is right there.

hallway_4.name: Seoyeon
hallway_4.text: And this isn't something I show just anyone. *She takes a silver key from her jacket pocket and jingles it on her fingertips.*

hallway_5.name: Seoyeon
hallway_5.text: The roof at our school is usually locked. This key is a small privilege only the student council president gets to use.

hallway_6.name: {name}
hallway_6.text: You hiding a secret hideout of your own up on the roof?

hallway_6_b.name: Seoyeon
hallway_6_b.text: *The clear jingle of the key ring stops short in her hand.* Quicker on the uptake than I thought.

hallway_6_c.name: Seoyeon
hallway_6_c.text: *The corner of her mouth lifts a little, and instead of answering she slips the key deep into her pocket.*

hallway_7.name: Seoyeon
hallway_7.text: Right, lunch today. If you haven't decided where to eat yet, want to come with me?

hallway_8.name: {name}
hallway_8.text: *Seoyeon has already stopped, and she points at the classroom plaque in the morning sunlight.*

hallway_10.name: Seoyeon
hallway_10.text: We're here. This is your classroom. Go on in.

hallway_11.name: {name}
hallway_11.text: You're guiding me one-on-one at lunch too?

hallway_12.name: Seoyeon
hallway_12.text: We'll see. Depends on you getting through this morning's classes.

hallway_13.name: Seoyeon
hallway_13.text: *As she turns, Seoyeon lifts the clipboard to shoulder height in a light goodbye and leaves a smile.*

hallway_13_b.name: {name}
hallway_13_b.text: *I watch Seoyeon's back for a moment as she heads off down the hall, the neat sound of her shoes left behind.*

classroom_1.name: {name}
classroom_1.text: *The front door rattles open, and dozens of eyes turn at once on the noisy classroom.* Hello.

classroom_2_b.name: {name}
classroom_2_b.text: *In front of the podium stands the homeroom teacher, who looks to be in her late 20s. In a soft beige cardigan with the top button undone, she holds the attendance book and greets me.*

classroom_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_3.text: Alright, everyone, eyes up. Starting today, this transfer student is part of our class. Come up front and say a quick hello?

classroom_3_b.name: {name}
classroom_3_b.text: I'm {name}. I transferred in today. Nice to meet you. *I finish the greeting and look up. The homeroom teacher marks a neat dot beside my name in the attendance book, smiling with her eyes.*

classroom_5_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_5_b.text: Good, {name}. Welcome to our class. No need to rush, so take your time settling in.

classroom_5_c.name: {name}
classroom_5_c.text: *As my breathing settles into the unfamiliar classroom air, a playful whistle rings out bright from one corner.*

classroom_dain_1.name: Dain
classroom_dain_1.text: Oh, a transfer student! Finally, a new face in our class!

classroom_dain_2.name: Dain
classroom_dain_2.text: Over here, over here! *A girl with a crisp brown bob, in a sporty volleyball uniform, springs up from her seat and waves wide.*

classroom_dain_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_3.text: Dain, keep your voice down. It's morning. And I told you to take that gym uniform off in the classroom.

classroom_dain_4.name: Dain
classroom_dain_4.text: Aw, come on, teach. This is the most comfortable thing in the world! Anyway, transfer student, so glad you're here!

classroom_dain_5.name: Dain
classroom_dain_5.text: Your seat's here, right here! *Through the kids' laughter, she stretches a springy arm even higher and waves.*

classroom_dain_5_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_5_b.text: Dain, at least settle down while I call attendance. *With the hand holding the chalk, she taps the podium lightly, twice.*

classroom_dain_5_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_5_c.text: What if you burn all that energy now? The period 1 bell hasn't even rung.

classroom_dain_5_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_5_d.text: *The homeroom teacher gives a small shake of her head and gently turns to the next page of the attendance book.*

classroom_yuna_1.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_1.text: *Apart from the noisy classroom, in the last seat by the window, only the girl with silver-white hair in the spring sun quietly turns a page.*

classroom_yuna_4.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_4.text: *A student in the front row brushes my sleeve and whispers. "Don't talk to her. The rumors are kind of scary." Even then, Yuna's pale fingertips turn the next page without the slightest twitch.*

classroom_seat_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_seat_1.text: *The homeroom teacher closes the attendance book and points to an empty seat one row in from the window.*

classroom_seat_2.name: Dain
classroom_seat_2.text: Oh, right next to me? Don't just stand there. Come sit! *She pulls her chair in tight and turns her upper body fully toward me.*

classroom_minsu_1.name: {name}
classroom_minsu_1.text: *I set my bag down and start to pull the chair out when the boy in front grabs the backrest and whips around.*

classroom_minsu_2.name: Minsu
classroom_minsu_2.text: Hey, transfer. Welcome to our class. And one warning up front: brace yourself.

classroom_minsu_2_b.name: Minsu
classroom_minsu_2_b.text: *He flicks his chin toward Dain beside me and grins.* If you want to keep up with the stamina next to you, you'd better start managing yours now.

classroom_dain_talk_1.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_1.text: *The uniform name tag on the boy in front, turning back with a grin, read "Minsu."*

classroom_dain_talk_2.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_2.text: Don't mind what that guy said! More importantly, can I ask you one thing I'm curious about? *She leans in so far her upper body crosses the edge of my desk.*

classroom_dain_talk_3.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_3.text: Hey, {name}. You like moving around, or sports?

classroom_dain_talk_4.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_4.text: Sports? Why, all of a sudden?

classroom_dain_talk_5.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_5.text: No, I want extra receive practice after school today, and I don't have anyone decent to send me the ball.

classroom_dain_talk_6.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_6.text: Using the transfer student as a human ball machine from day one?

classroom_dain_talk_7.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_7.text: No way! Still, syncing up with a person is way more fun than a machine. Probably!

classroom_dain_talk_8.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_8.text: So, want to try it together? *Dain's warm index finger sketches a tiny volleyball court and a net line across the wood grain of my desk.*

classroom_yuna_note_1.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_1.text: *Then a neatly folded note slides in from the seat behind, onto the corner of my desk. I turn, and the silver-haired girl acts like it wasn't her, staring only at the branches swaying outside the window.*

classroom_yuna_note_3.name: Yuna
classroom_yuna_note_3.text: *I unfold it carefully, and pale lavender ink comes into view, with a small crease at the corner.* Noisy seat from day one. — Yuna

classroom_yuna_note_5.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_5.text: *When I look up, Yuna's pale fingertips, caught in the window light, slip without a sound into the shade under her desk.*

classroom_yuna_note_6.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_6.text: *The bell for period 1 fills the classroom. Between Yuna's cool profile turned toward the window and the heat of Dain chattering without a stop, my first day was beginning.*
